"""RoboPaint episode record. All motion uses the public robot client.
Coordinates and brush calibration derived solely from RGB/depth and proprioception.
Commands are recorded in actions.jsonl; replay is intentionally never automatic.
"""
import sys,json,os,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT='/app/output'
r=Robot()
Q=[0.,1.,0.,0.]
def obs(label='obs',depth=False):
    a=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=depth)
    save(a,label)
    return a
def save(a,label):
    a.save(f'{OUT}/{label}')
    for c,v in a.last.items(): Image.fromarray(v).save(f'{OUT}/{label}_{c}.png')
    print(label, 'tip',a.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14], 'left',a.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)
def send(points,label,dt=.05,cameras=['practice_cam','side_cam']):
    p=np.asarray(points)
    if p.shape[1]==3:p=np.c_[p,np.tile(Q,(len(p),1))]
    with open(f'{OUT}/actions.jsonl','a') as f: f.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'dt':dt,'points':p.tolist()})+'\n')
    a=r.submit('ee_pose',p,dt=dt,cameras=cameras,video='frames',video_fps=10,note=label)
    save(a,label)
    print('plan',a.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
    return a
def move(p,label='move',t=2):
    a=r.get_obs(cameras=[])
    start=np.array(a.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10])
    return send(np.linspace(start,p,int(t/.05)+1)[1:],label)
if __name__=='__main__':
    exec(sys.stdin.read())

  if len(pts)<2:continue
  dis,idx=cKDTree(p).query(pts)
  q=np.argmin(dis);k=idx[q]
  # Tiny cores have no holes; nearest-neighbor traversal remains inside the stroke.
  seq=[pts[q]];todo=np.delete(pts,q,axis=0)
  while len(todo):
   q=np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(todo-seq[-1],axis=1));seq.append(todo[q]);todo=np.delete(todo,q,axis=0)
  p=np.r_[p[:k+1],seq,list(reversed(seq)),p[k:]]
